text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...The color of the ribbon seems just 
right. It makes the flowers stand out 
beautifully.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yeah, all done. So pretty...

Mid-December, the Christmas season, when 
the town was beginning to bustle with 
festive cheer.
Today, I had a special promise with her—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, what a lovely bouquet. Pink roses, 
baby's breath, tulips—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Did you tie this together for me, Trainer?
choice_data_list: While getting advice from the clerk—

text_block_list.name: Florist Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"You promised to exchange bouquets with 
someone dear to you? My, how lovely!"

text_block_list.name: Florist Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to help! There are some flowers 
I'd highly recommend for this season—

“—Yes. That special promise was to make 
bouquets for each other and exchange 
them.”

With the Twinkle Series reaching a natural 
stopping point, I accepted her suggestion, 
thinking it a good opportunity to express 
my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? ...How wonderful. There's a 
sense of strength within its loveliness—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I want to continue being— the person you 
believe I am, just like this."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for the lovely 
bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"From me— please allow me to give you 
this."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"A blue rose is the embodiment of a dream. 
Truly, a miracle flower—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Your wonderful personality, your feelings 
for Umamusume, and the miracle of meeting 
a Trainer like you— I've gathered them all 
together into a bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...As I tied them together, I was 
reminiscing about everything up until now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Days spent gathering flowers one by one 
and tying them into a bouquet in the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Sweet peas and spring chrysanthemums. 
Sunflowers, and a single golden blossom—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was collecting them all for 
your sake, but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, each and every single 
flower— was linked to my growing 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
("Could it be that I'm disrupting the 
'harmony' of the race?"—as if.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I don't think like that anymore.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "...―― I'm so glad I met you."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ... As I hand you the bouquet, I—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I was giving a bouquet to myself 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It is filled with my gratitude, too, 
for gifting me such a miraculous feeling.

The bouquet I received was heavy and 
carried the gentle fragrance of fresh 
flowers.

Over these three years, she taught me the 
most important lesson of being a Trainer.
choice_data_list: I'm proud I got to walk by your side.
I'm proud I got to walk by your side

text_block_list.text:
Not just supporting her, but walking 
alongside her. —And the grand dream she 
gave me, to make her presence known to the 
entire world.

Being able to spend those days was true 
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. Your words are far 
too kind.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep this tucked away in my heart 
forever and ever. Along with the scent of 
the flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: FufuâMerry Christmas.

As she raises her head, I follow her gaze. 
...Snow had begun to fall.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: A White Christmas, isn't it?

She gently opened the window and looked 
down to the floor below.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how beautiful—a true Christmas 
harmony.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"The trees lit up in blue and the red of 
the poinsettias stand out beautifully 
against the white snow."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If you'd be so kind... would you please 
take a photo with me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to preserve the memory of 
this special day.
choice_data_list: Of course, let's take a picture.

text_block_list.text: (Splash...!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —A lovely smile.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't forget. Neither today, nor all 
the days leading up to it."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how far into the future we may 
go one day—"
